title: Spring & Spring Boot fundamentals
summary: Move from plain Java to production-grade backend development while understanding what the framework is doing for you.
why: Move from plain Java to production-grade backend development while understanding what the framework is doing for you.
outcomes: Explain Spring & Spring Boot fundamentals in your own words
Implement a small working example of Spring & Spring Boot fundamentals
Debug a realistic failure related to Spring & Spring Boot fundamentals
lab: Build the same small service once with plain Java wiring and once with Spring; explain exactly what Spring automates.

title: HTTP & REST API design
summary: Design APIs as long-lived contracts rather than controller methods.
why: Design APIs as long-lived contracts rather than controller methods.
outcomes: Explain HTTP & REST API design in your own words
Implement a small working example of HTTP & REST API design
Debug a realistic failure related to HTTP & REST API design
lab: Design and implement a versioned task API with idempotent create, pagination, problem-details errors and an OpenAPI contract.

title: GraphQL, gRPC, WebSockets & webhooks
summary: Choose communication styles based on product and operational constraints.
why: Choose communication styles based on product and operational constraints.
outcomes: Explain GraphQL, gRPC, WebSockets & webhooks in your own words
Implement a small working example of GraphQL, gRPC, WebSockets & webhooks
Debug a realistic failure related to GraphQL, gRPC, WebSockets & webhooks
lab: Implement one use case with REST and gRPC or GraphQL, then write a trade-off memo including caching, tooling and failure handling.

title: SQL & relational data modeling
summary: Model business truth cleanly and query it fluently.
why: Model business truth cleanly and query it fluently.
outcomes: Explain SQL & relational data modeling in your own words
Implement a small working example of SQL & relational data modeling
Debug a realistic failure related to SQL & relational data modeling
lab: Model organisations, projects, tasks, comments, memberships and permissions. Write analytical and operational queries.

title: Database internals & transactions
summary: Understand why queries are slow or transactions conflict instead of treating the database as a black box.
why: Understand why queries are slow or transactions conflict instead of treating the database as a black box.
outcomes: Explain Database internals & transactions in your own words
Implement a small working example of Database internals & transactions
Debug a realistic failure related to Database internals & transactions
lab: Reproduce phantom/non-repeatable behaviours, deadlocks and bad query plans. Fix each and explain why the fix works.

title: JPA, Hibernate & persistence boundaries
summary: Use ORMs without allowing them to dictate your domain or hide database costs.
why: Use ORMs without allowing them to dictate your domain or hide database costs.

Implement a small working example of JPA, Hibernate & persistence boundaries
Debug a realistic failure related to JPA, Hibernate & persistence boundaries
lab: Build persistence for the collaboration app; intentionally create N+1 and transaction-boundary bugs, then diagnose with SQL logging.

title: NoSQL & specialized storage
summary: Choose storage by access pattern, consistency and operational needs—not fashion.
why: Choose storage by access pattern, consistency and operational needs—not fashion.
outcomes: Explain NoSQL & specialized storage in your own words
Implement a small working example of NoSQL & specialized storage
Debug a realistic failure related to NoSQL & specialized storage
lab: For five product features, choose relational, key-value, document, search, object or graph storage and defend each choice.

title: Caching
summary: Treat caching as a consistency system with failure modes, not a magic speed switch.
why: Treat caching as a consistency system with failure modes, not a magic speed switch.
outcomes: Explain Caching in your own words
Implement a small working example of Caching
Debug a realistic failure related to Caching
lab: Add Redis cache-aside to a read-heavy endpoint. Reproduce stale data and stampede, then add mitigation and metrics.

title: Background jobs & schedulers
summary: Design reliable asynchronous work that can retry, resume and avoid duplicate side effects.
why: Design reliable asynchronous work that can retry, resume and avoid duplicate side effects.
outcomes: Explain Background jobs & schedulers in your own words
Implement a small working example of Background jobs & schedulers
Debug a realistic failure related to Background jobs & schedulers
lab: Build a scheduled digest pipeline with retries, idempotent execution and a recoverable job-state model.

title: Queues, messaging & pub/sub
summary: Use asynchronous messaging to decouple work while reasoning about delivery, ordering and backpressure.
why: Use asynchronous messaging to decouple work while reasoning about delivery, ordering and backpressure.

Implement a small working example of Queues, messaging & pub/sub
Debug a realistic failure related to Queues, messaging & pub/sub

title: Kafka & event streaming

Implement a small working example of Kafka & event streaming

Implement a small working example of Search systems & information retrieval
